capabilities.why: Enables SpaceV to checkpoint full hardware state in sub-200ms before detonating untrusted code and roll back cleanly if Step 7 encounters malicious exfiltration or runtime corruption.
Enforces pre-execution command introspection to detect and block reverse shells, canary token exfiltration, and destructive filesystem mutations before they reach the guest kernel.
Enforces hardware-level air-gapping by disabling outbound network access, ensuring zero outbound leakage of canary credentials even under active prompt injection.
